items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 28:1
items.html: It is known that through the illumination of AB-SAG of AK in Atzilut, the Parsas between the Partzufim are nullified — those being the borders of the second restriction that came about through the ascent of the HET to the eyes. For then the HET descends from the eyes to the mouth, and the AHAP return to their level. Now, at that time there are two aspects of ascent in Arich Anpin: first, that the first three of Arich Anpin ascend to Atik, for they are the aspect of the AHAP of Atik, and since the HET descended to the mouth of Atik, the three heads have become joined with the body of Atik into one level. And the second ascent is from its own AHAP, for within it too the concealed Hochma, which is the aspect of the eyes, was corrected in the screen of the HET, and it brought out Bina and ZON into the body — namely the throat and HGT, as is known. And now that the Parsa is nullified and the HET descended to the mouth, the throat and HGT ascended and joined with the head of Arich Anpin; and the HGT became its HBD.
